svg.title: Smoothly blending monotone slices into a bivariate target
svg.desc: Three-panel illustration. First, a ridgeline stack shows monotone functions of x2 generated at evenly spaced x1 grid points. Second, an x1 value between two adjacent grid points determines a relative coordinate t and smoothstep weight w of t. Third, the two adjacent monotone curves are combined by a convex blend, which remains monotone in x2 and joins neighboring intervals smoothly in x1.
svg.text: (b) Locate x1 and compute its weight
Adjacent intervals meet C2-smoothly in x1.
The convex blend remains increasing in x2.
